lines.text: The Goddess of Victory statue advances.
It moves forward with a single-minded focus.
Because of its overwhelming size, regenerative abilities, and defensive capabilities, our attacks have been fruitless.
... Should I spray some blood on it?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: That's not a good idea. Did you forget doing that caused me to transform?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Then again, it might get downgraded to something like mecha Leviathan.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I told you not to call me that!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: L-let's transform and try to stop it.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: If we all transform and try to stop it, do you think it'll react somehow?

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Wow, you know how to transform, too?

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: Four Heretics versed in the art of transformation. my Lord truly doth know how to make an ally of anyone.

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Save it. We don't know what's inside that thing.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Still, I don't think it's a good idea to just let that thing keep moving unchecked.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: But why does that thing keep moving forward?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Worst-case scenario, it may be trying to get within range to attack the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Don't say that. Your words somehow always end up coming true—
*Rumble*
... The statue comes to a halt.
The constant vibration suddenly ceases, leaving an eerie sense of stillness.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... What the heck?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: It stopped. Now's our chance to attack—

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: ... Stay thy hand. Something doth not sit right.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: The air is vibrating.
*Screeeeeech*
With a piercing noise, the sky turns red.
No... the red light at the very top of the statue is gathering.
The light grows stronger, and the screeching grows louder.
As the ground shakes, I look up toward the sky.
The clouds that once filled the sky above the statue disperse.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Hang on...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Everyone! Flash incoming!
*Crack!*
A sharp crack echoes as the entire area trembles.
The shockwaves send me flying.
As I fly through the air...
The world is bathed entirely in red.
Shooting straight out from the top of the statue...
is an enormous beam of light.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It's pointing toward the Ark!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: N-no!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Damn it...!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Extremely high-energy signature detected. It's approaching the Ark at incredible speed.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It's likely a beam weapon fired from the giant object.
After fending off successive attacks from Annihilio and the Raptures, Matis and the Ark Rangers were taking some time to regroup and perform maintenance.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: How's everyone holding up?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: No problems here!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Annihilio, was it? I'm starting to get the hang of fighting this thing.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Hehehe. It's just a missile. It's no match for a villain.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: ... Was Dorothy the only one aboard the Wings of Victory?

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: I think so.

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: I guess that means she took down Annihilio twice on her own now.

lines.speaker: arkrangerblack
lines.text: ... Incredible. The Goddess Squad really lives up to its name.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: By the way, I haven't seen the Wings of Victory for a while now.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Well... it's probably off for maintenance or resupply.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: You don't exactly see an aircraft carrier that size flying through the air every day.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: Well, that's a relief. I was worried something might've happened to it.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Put your faith in Dorothy! She's super strong!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Hmph. All that strength means nothing against my villain power...

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: What's wrong?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Something tingles... No, it stings.
Drake abruptly turns to look at the distant horizon.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Wh-what's gotten into you? You're freaking me out. Don't start acting all weird.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: ... Duck.

lines.speaker: blue
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Duck! Take cover!

lines.speaker: red
lines.text: What is it? What's going—
The horizon suddenly turns red.
The crimson hue deepens, soon engulfing the entire area.
Before long, the ground and air begin to vibrate.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: ... What in the world?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Ugh...!
Drake springs into action, forcing everyone to the ground.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Don't lift your heads! Brace for impact!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: What the hell is going on?!
With a deafening explosion,
the ground trembles violently.
Everyone on the ground fixes their eyes on the same spot.
An enormous beam of red light races past, as if trying to split the world in two.
*Rooooooar!*
With a tremendous roar, the entire Ark shakes violently.
It's an earthquake of unprecedented magnitude.
Buildings' windows shatter, and floor tiles buck and shift.
Weaker buildings lose their structural integrity and collapse.
That shock makes its way down to the shelters as well.
Somebody screams upon feeling the sudden tremors.
The terror is infectious, and soon the shelters are reduced to pandemonium.
However, nobody attempts to run to the shelter entrance.
They all remember what happened to those who ran outside the shelters during the terrorist attack on the Ark.
People simply huddle under the flickering lights,
praying there won't be another.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Ugh...!

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Enikk! Situation report!

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The attack missed by two kilometers.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Two kilometers? And yet the shaking was that strong?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I'm pulling up the situation on the surface on-screen now.
Burningum watches the surface feed on the screen.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: What is that thing? Was there something like that near the Ark?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It's a mountain.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Correction. It was a mountain.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: You mean... that attack did this to a mountain?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That's correct.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: That's absurd... A single entity couldn't possibly do something like that.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: The entity in question is the Queen.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: It's an ultra-long-range shot. The first attack missed.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: I'm certain the next attack will hit its mark.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Can we intercept it?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: That won't be possible.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: When do you think the next attack will come?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: There's no way of knowing.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: We're trying to establish communications with the region, but heavy jamming is preventing us from doing so.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Initiate the Ark's ascent sequence immediately.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: If we're going to get hit by that thing again, we're better off taking the hit on the surface.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: None of us would survive it underground.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Are there any forces we can immediately send to the surface, aside from those already stationed there?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: No. Most of the elevators have already been dismantled.

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: Expedite the ascent as much as possible.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_l
lines.text: Understood.
*Beep*

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: burningum
lines.text: This isn't how I wanted the ascent to go.
We witness light erupting beyond the horizon.
A massive tremor causes shockwaves to ripple all the way to us.
A sense of foreboding slowly creeps over the group.

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: What utter absurdity...!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... This is insane. What in the world was that?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: The Queen...!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: D-don't tell me...

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: It can't be. D-don't tell me the Ark was destroyed!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It'll... it'll be fine. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: H-how would you even know...?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: C-Commander!
Anis looks at me before turning her head toward the statue.
It appears completely still...
but it's moving ever so slightly.
... No! The Ark is okay!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Like I said, how would you even know that...?!
The statue is repositioning itself! It's obviously correcting its trajectory!
If it had hit its mark, it wouldn't have to do that! That means the Ark is safe!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: R-right...! I get it now!
But it won't miss next time! We have to stop it!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Then we'd better aim for the head, right? Well, it doesn't have a head, but somewhere around there!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Yes! We should aim for the place where it fired the beam from!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Gravity field or not, we need to do whatever it takes to get up there!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: ... Get on! I-I'll fly up!
Ziz spreads her black wings wide.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm going too! I can carry one person with me!
Seven Dwarves Zero begins to rattle.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: I can jump up with one person in my arms too.
Rapunzel's halo glows.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I, the ever-brilliant Bahamut, can summon pillars to any height.
Bahamut's black pillar shoots up from the ground.
... I'm sorry, everyone! I don't have a plan!
But we still have to do whatever we can to stop it!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Rog—
*Boooom!*
Suddenly, the midsection of the Goddess of Victory statue explodes.
It looks as if it exploded from the inside. Does that mean someone's inside...?
*Rumble!*

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Damn it...

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... What a pain.
... Raptures come pouring out of the enormous hole in the statue's midsection.
They keep pouring out endlessly.
Once they hit the ground, they move in perfect coordination.
The Raptures don't pay us any attention.
They all head straight for the Ark.
It was acting as a transport vessel too!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: 'Tis little short of a battle cruiser.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Maybe transportation isn't its only purpose.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It might even be making Raptures in there. That thing is just a mass of Dark Matter.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Haha. I have no idea what we're supposed to do.
The Raptures continue pouring out,
and the statue slowly moves, correcting its aim.
As Behemoth said, I don't even know what we're supposed to do.
Should we head to the Ark and help them? Or should we try to stop the statue?

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: Why are you just standing there?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander!
Have faith in the Ark! Ignore the Raptures and attack the statue!
We have to interfere with its targeting! If that thing fires again, the Ark is finished!
Everyone, unleash maximum firepower on the statue!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Leave this to me.
I hear a familiar voice.
We all turn to look behind us.
Marian is walking up to us.
Marian...?
*Tap*
Marian taps her staff on the ground.
*Whooosh!*
Black spears erupt from the ground, piercing the lower half of the statue.
The statue's movements halt.
*Tap*
Marian taps her staff on the ground again.
... Dark Matter begins to gather in the air.
Soon, it takes the shape of a large spear,
before stabbing into the statue's midsection.
The stream of Raptures pouring out the statue's abdomen comes to a stop.
I turn to look at Marian.
With a tearful expression,
Marian looks at me and smiles.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Commander.
Marian!
I run to her.
Marian holds out her hand.
... A strange feeling comes over me.
Part of me feels like I should take her hand, while another part tells I mustn't.
I stare at Marian.
She has an odd expression on her face.
... I'm probably wearing the same expression.
Even so, I approach her.
I reach out my hand to take hers.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Don't come any closer!
... Marian?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'm... concentrating right now. If you come any closer, you might get hurt.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: You can talk to me from there, all right?
What...? Something strange is going on.
Marian, what's—

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Marian...! Are you okay now?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You should've told us you were coming!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Wow! It's been forever!

lines.speaker: snowwhite_h
lines.text: ... You're here.

lines.speaker: rapunzel_s
lines.text: Ah...! I'm so... relieved!

lines.speaker: hongryeon_g
lines.text: By my troth, it hath been quite some time for us both.
Marian looks at us.
Her eyes are brimming with tears.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... Yes. I'm so glad I got to see you all again.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... Who's that?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Sh-she... she was the one asleep in Eden...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Ah. Now I remember.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: You only just remembered? I, the astute Bahamut, recognized her right away.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: You. What did you do with the kid?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That Dark Matter you're using... It's hers! I know! I can tell!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: So what did you do...?!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: What did you do to her?!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I took it.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Her Dark Matter, her gene, her core. I took all of it.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Did you kill her...?

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... What? No, I would never.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Then how did you get it...?!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I asked her, and she gave it to me.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: She's asleep now in Eden. Don't worry.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Why would she give that to you?! Do you honestly expect me to believe that?!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Please believe me. The girl—
*Crack, snap!*
I frantically turn to the Goddess of Victory statue.
The spears put there by Marian are starting to twist and break apart.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: ... We don't have time to talk right now.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'll take care of that thing.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: You guys head to the Ark.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Go to the Ark and bring back anyone who can help us fight this thing.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I can't hold out long. I have no way of knowing its true power.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: There's no way. How are you supposed to face that thing alone?!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Rapi.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'm the Queen now.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Go. All of you.
What in the world are you...?
*Tap*
Marian lightly taps her staff on the ground.
*Gurgle*
Dark Matter bubbles and shoots up from the ground.
It washes over us like a small wave, pushing us away from Marian.
It's so heavy that I can't fight it off.
Moving at incredible speed, it drives us away in an instant.
Marian!!

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I'll be waiting.
I catch a glimpse of Marian's faint smile before she disappears from view.
Marian looks up at the Goddess of Victory statue.
The black spears she stabbed it with are falling apart.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: Just as I thought... That was only enough to slow you down for a bit.
*Shatter!*
The black spears all shatter into pieces, and the statue moves.
*Screeeeech!*
The sky turns red, and the ground begins to tremble.
Marian recalls the red sky she saw once before.

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: This time, I swear...

lines.speaker: marian_queen
lines.text: I will defeat you.
Black light bursts forth from Marian's body.
And then...
A pitch-black moon swallows the statue.
